## Big idea

- **Unit test:** class in isolation (mock deps with Mockito)
- **Slice / MockMvc test:** HTTP layer without full server
- **Integration test:** `@SpringBootTest` with real context

## Practice

1. Unit-test service with mocked repository.
2. `@WebMvcTest` controller with `MockMvc`.
3. Assert JSON status and body.
